title: sdks: unify auth/retries + streaming ergonomics, parity fixes, v1.88.1
author: Priya Shah
description: Unify authentication and retry semantics across Python, TypeScript, and Go SDKs; improve streaming ergonomics and fix small parity regressions ahead of the v1.88.1 SDK release. Motivation: customers reported inconsistent retry behavior and confusing streaming callbacks across languages, which caused subtle bugs in Redwood-hosted streaming endpoints and in Dedicated/private deployments. This PR consolidates the auth token refresh + retry middleware into a shared spec, exposes a consistent streaming iterator API in Python/TS/Go that aligns with server-side chunking guarantees, and applies a set of parity patches (error codes, header handling, telemetry tags). Changes are backwards-compatible for normal usage patterns but include a recommended minor-version bump for SDKs. Checklist: - [x] Define unified auth+retry spec and document in SDK contributing docs - [x] Implement middleware for Python/TS/Go using shared behavior tests - [x] Stream API ergonomic improvements: Python async iterator + context manager, TS async iterable + improved types, Go io.Reader-friendly stream helper - [x] Add cross-language integration tests and e2e streaming test against staging gateway - [x] Update changelogs and release notes for v1.88.1 - [x] Run full CI and perf smoke tests Notes: see Linear ENG-2198 for detailed design and timeline. This description contains a high-level summary; review the commit list and files changed for implementation details.

review_comments: Liam Chen: Can we ensure the retry backoff is configurable per-client and per-route? Also suggest exposing a hook for logging retry attempts.
Author (Priya Shah): Backoff is configurable on the client options; added per-route override and exposed on_retry callback in all three SDKs (see python/ts/go API docs).
Erin Patel: TypeScript types look good but I hit a lint failure on CI related to promise-returning iterator. Fixed by ensuring async iterable implements Symbol.asyncIterator.
Diego Rivera: Go StreamReader helper is nice. Suggest adding a Close() on the reader to release underlying connection sooner.
Author (Priya Shah): Added Close() and accompanied tests; updated e2e to assert early-close behavior.
Erin Patel (Approve): LGTM with the added tests and docs.
Liam Chen (Approve): Approving verified cross-language e2e on staging, CI green.
release_notes: SDKs (Python/TypeScript/Go) v1.88.1: unified auth+retry middleware, improved streaming ergonomics (consistent async iterators/stream reader helpers), parity fixes for header/error handling, minor behavioral improvements around retry hooks. Backwards-compatible; recommended to upgrade for consistent streaming behavior.
additional_notes: CI: full matrix passed after second run; a transient integration test failed once due to staging gateway flakiness and was retriggered. Perf smoke tests show <2% overhead for added middleware on p50 latency. No customer-facing breaking changes identified.
